channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: TSE proíbe Flávio Bolsonaro de impulsionar publicação anti-Lula
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça banned Flávio Bolsonaro from sharing an anti-Lula video on social media, responding to a request from the Coligação Brasil Pronto Pra Mais. The ruling restricts the dissemination of electoral content targeting the PT candidate.

item.title: Pressionada por 6x1, oposição tenta dar o troco com redução da maioridade
item.description: The opposition, led by Rogério Marinho, attempts to modify President Lula's Security PEC by adding a reduction of the age of majority to the text under discussion in the Senate. The maneuver seeks to neutralize one of Lula's electoral banners for the 2026 elections, while facing strong political resistance.

item.title: Vou governar até para petistas; verão que, com Bolsonaro, democracia está garantida, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated that if elected, he will govern for everyone, including PT supporters, ensuring democracy is secured under his administration. He emphasized the need to unite the country after years of political strife.

item.title: TSE manda apagar fake news que associam Lula a ritual satânico na Paulista
item.description: The TSE ordered the removal of fake news linking Lula to a satanic ritual on Paulista Avenue, following an injunction by Minister Estela Aranha. The false content, which went viral on social media, uses images from the 4th March for Exu held in August, decontextualized from the pro-Lula demonstration. The decision aims to prevent the spread of misinformation ahead of the runoff election.

item.title: Quaest mostra que a transferência de votos não está salvando Lula
item.description: The first Quaest poll of the runoff keeps Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, with rejection above 50% for both candidates. Vote transfers from figures like Ronaldo Caiado, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury are not helping Lula, according to analysis on Papo Antagonista. Young voters and second-round dynamics are central to the debate.

item.title: PSD recorre ao STF para tentar garantir 2º turno no Rio
item.description: The PSD filed a lawsuit at the STF attempting to restore the 2nd round of the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial election, after the TSE annulled Anthony Garotinho's votes and confirmed Douglas Ruas's first-round victory. The party argues that Garotinho's votes should be considered in determining whether a 2nd round is necessary.

item.title: Por que a ofensiva religiosa de Lula dificilmente vai convencer evangélicos
item.description: Lula's religious outreach, including the 'Cristãos com Lula' WhatsApp channel and support from Banco do Brasil figures, aims to attract evangelicals and Catholics, but experts argue his religiosity lacks authenticity. This approach is unlikely to persuade evangelicals who prioritize ideological alignment over symbolic gestures.

item.title: Lula aciona TSE contra Flávio e Campopiano por ‘deepfake’
item.description: Lula's coalition (PT) filed a lawsuit with the TSE against Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Eduarda Campopiano (PL-SP) for alleged dissemination of deepfake using AI-manipulated imagery. The image simulated a black worker cleaning graffiti in the subway.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro registra presença e deve votar PEC da 6x1 no Senado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) attended a Senate session virtually and is expected to vote in favor of the PEC ending the 6×1 work scale. Although initially opposed, he justified his support due to popular pressure and advocated for greater flexibility in work schedules.

item.title: Flaviômetro no ar: bolsonarismo passa a cobrar aliados em público
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign introduced the Flaviômetro, a platform tracking allies' support for the PL candidate. The tool is compared to the 'Exército do Lula' and discusses loyalty demands within the bolsonarismo.

item.title: Renata Lo Prete entrevista Lula, candidato à reeleição pelo PT, nesta quinta (15)
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, candidate for re-election by the PT, will give an interview to journalist Renata Lo Prete on Thursday (15), broadcast live on Globo, G1, and GloboNews. The interview will air after the National Journal and later be made available on Globoplay and G1. On Friday (16), candidate Flávio Bolsonaro from the PL will be interviewed in the same format.

item.title: Renata Lo Prete entrevista Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato à Presidência pelo PL, na sexta (16)
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate from PL, gives an interview to journalist Renata Lo Prete on Friday (16), broadcast live from Globo Studios after the National News. The interview will also air on g1 and GloboNews, with the full recording available on Globaplay. Lula from PT will be interviewed the day before.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro faz agenda no RS em dia de votação sobre escala 6x1 e ignora assunto em comício
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a campaign event in RS on the day of the PEC 6x1 vote in the Senate, without addressing the topic publicly. The presidential candidate avoided commenting on the proposal regarding the end of the 6x1 work schedule.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro foi cadastrado como 'usuário master' em conta bancária de empresa de advogado investigado
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating Flávio Bolsonaro for being registered as a master user of a bank account belonging to lawyer Willer Tomaz's company, who is under investigation for money laundering. The registration would have granted operational access to the account, raising suspicions of economic participation, though both deny business ties.

item.title: Campanha de Lula avalia interferência no Grok e X, mas prioriza Meta
item.description: Lula's campaign claims Meta favors Flávio Bolsonaro in WhatsApp AI interactions while monitoring possible interference on Grok and X, but prioritizes Meta as it accounts for 90% of reported cases. Camilo Santana denounced technical failures on Lula's profile and stated the campaign will file complaints with OAS, ANPD, and TSE. Meta denies the allegations, asserting the claims are false.

item.title: Flávio aciona TSE contra rede de perfis ligados a Lula por fake news
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE demanding the removal of 221 posts and suspension of 32 profiles, alleging a coordinated network spread misinformation tied to politicians and entities aligned with Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The action aims to curb electoral disinformation ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Justiça nega pedido de Flávio para Janones e Lindbergh se retratarem
item.description: The District of Brazil's Federal Court denied Flávio Bolsonaro's preliminary injunction request requiring André Janones and Lindbergh Farias to publicly retract statements made in a video attributing pension reform proposals to the candidate. Judge Grace Correa Pereira ruled that the parties must be heard and evidence analyzed before determining if there was abuse, emphasizing that political criticism is legitimate as long as it does not involve false information. The case proceeds to trial on the merits.

item.title: Câmara aprova aumento no limite de receita bruta do MEI
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved the increase of the gross revenue cap for Individual Microentrepreneurs (MEI) from R$81,000 to R$140,000 by 2028, allowing the hiring of up to two employees earning a minimum wage. The project also provides debt forgiveness for MEIs listed in the federal debt until October 2026, requiring tax compliance for six months following enactment. The measure now moves to the Senate for review.

item.title: Campanhas de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro não chegam a acordo e critérios para registro de canais podem ir a plenário
item.description: The legal teams of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro failed to reach an agreement on criteria for registering WhatsApp campaign channels, particularly regarding when a third-party channel becomes part of the campaign. If no consensus is reached, the matter will go to the TSE plenary. The debate gained traction after the TSE president took down the 'Exército do Lula' channel.

item.title: Quaest: 43% dos eleitores que se abstiveram no primeiro turno declaram voto em Lula no segundo
item.description: Quaest poll for the presidential runoff shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (46%) and Lula (44%), within the margin of error. Among abstainers from round one, 43% lean Lula and 38% lean Flávio; vote transfers from Caiado, Renan and Cury also favor Lula.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest: Vicentinho Júnior tem 49% e Professora Dorinha, 42% no Tocantins
item.description: Quaest poll shows Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) leading with 49% against Professora Dorinha (União) at 42% in the Tocantins gubernatorial runoff, with 5% undecided. The same poll indicates Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of Lula in Tocantins by 48% to 42% in the presidential race.

item.title: Acompanhe ao vivo: Senado vota PEC pelo fim da escala 6x1
item.description: The Senate began voting on PEC 221/2019, which reduces the workday from 44 to 40 hours per week and establishes two weekly rest days, maintaining the 5x2 schedule. The proposal requires 49 votes in favor in each round to be approved and moves to promulgation after five discussion sessions.

item.title: Como está a disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro no Espírito Santo e Tocantins, segundo a Quaest
item.description: Quaest polling shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading over Lula (PT) in Espírito Santo (51% vs 38%) and Tocantins (48% vs 42%). Surveys were conducted between October 10-13 with a margin of error of three percentage points.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é denunciado ao MPE por ato de campanha no ‘Espaço Motoboy’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro was denounced to the MPE for alleged irregular use of public resources at the Espaço Motoboy in São Paulo. The PL candidate distributed pizzas and pastries to motoboys during an event alongside Ricardo Nunes and Tarcísio de Freitas.

item.title: Quem ficou em casa no 1º turno pode decidir a eleição, mostra Globo/Quaest
item.description: In the first Globo/Quaest poll of the runoff, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads with 46% of voting intentions, compared to 44% for Lula (PT), a technical tie within the margin of error. The outcome may hinge on voters who cast blank or null ballots or abstained in the first round, a group in which Lula leads by 43% to 38%. The survey also shows that much of Flávio's electorate decided their vote in the final week or on election Sunday, while 84% of Lula's voters had already chosen before the campaign began.

item.title: Vicentinho tem 49% e Dorinha 42% no 2º turno em TO, diz Quaest
item.description: A new poll by Quaest Shows That Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) Leads With 49% Of Voting Intentions, Followed By Professor Dorinha (União Brasil) With 42%, In The 2nd Round Race For The Tocantins Gubernatorial Elections. The Survey, Conducted Between October 10 And 13, 2026, Has A Margin Of Error Of 3 Percentage Points And A Confidence Level Of 95%.

item.title: Câmara aprova aumento no teto do MEI e perdão a dívidas
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved increasing the MEI revenue ceiling from R$81,000 to R$110,000 in 2027, reaching R$140,000 in 2028, along with full debt forgiveness for Union Active Debt. The proposal also expands the employee limit and allows temporary hires, integrating the federal Prospera MEI program.

item.title: Câmara aprova pacote eleitoral de Lula que perdoa dívidas e aumenta teto do MEI
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved President Lula's electoral package for individual micro-entrepreneurs (MEIs), increasing the revenue cap from R$81,000 to R$140,000 and writing off R$12.86 billion in tax debts. The measure, now heading to the Senate, aims to ease the burden on micro-entrepreneurs and enhance their competitiveness in both public and private sectors.

item.title: Entidades científicas divulgam carta em defesa da reeleição de Lula
item.description: Over 30 scientific education entities release a letter supporting Lula's re-election, emphasizing the need for a democratic, quality public school with proper funding. The collective criticizes simplistic proposals and school privatization, especially the expansion of military-style schools. Education professionals can sign the manifesto supporting inclusive public education.

item.title: Grassi rejeita apoiar Lula e cobra Flávio por propostas para animais
item.description: Presidential candidate Wilson Grassi (Democrat) rejected supporting Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the runoff and endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), citing family pressure and the lack of animal welfare proposals from the PL. Grassi delivered a letter with five proposals, including expanded federal support for public veterinary hospitals and an animal castration plan. So far, 132 people have signed the letter.

item.title: Câmara aprova projeto que amplia limite do MEI e perdoa dívidas de inadimplentes
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a bill expanding the revenue threshold for Individual Microentrepreneurs (MEI) and forgiving debts of delinquent individuals, a measure sent by President Lula before the runoff. The text now moves to the Senate.

item.title: Reunião de campanhas de Lula e Flávio no TSE sobre canais de WhatsApp termina sem acordo
item.description: The meeting between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) campaigns at the TSE regarding WhatsApp channels ended without an agreement, with a new session scheduled to set rules. The dispute centers on the boundary between independent support and official campaign communication.

item.title: Quaest: Vicentinho Júnior tem 49% no Tocantins, ante 42% de Professora Dorinha
item.description: A Quaest poll released on April 14, 2026 shows Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) with 49% of voter intentions, against 42% for Senator Professor Dorinha (União Brasil) in the second round of the Tocantins gubernatorial race. The gap between the candidates is seven percentage points, according to the survey conducted by Quaest.

item.title: Empate impõe aos candidatos comparecimento aos debates
item.description: After initially stating he would not attend the Band debate, Flávio Bolsonaro decided to participate in the showdown with Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on Sunday. He attributed the change of stance to a supposed strategy by Lula to force his attendance, though the explanation is questioned as contrived. The candidate had seriously considered not debating, planning to only participate in the Globo debate, the eve of the second round.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 46% e Lula soma 44% no 2º turno, mostra pesquisa Quaest
item.description: Quaest poll reveals a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (46%) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (44%) in the presidential runoff. The PL senator leads numerically but remains within the margin of error. Survey released on October 14, 2024.

item.title: Quaest: No 2º turno, Flávio tem 46% dos votos totais, contra 44% de Lula em empate técnico
item.description: The first Quaest poll for the 2026 runoff shows senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 46% of voter intent, against 44% for President Lula (PT). With a 2-point margin of error, both candidates are in a technical tie. The poll was released on Wednesday, the 14th, reflecting a tight race for the decisive election.

item.title: PSD vai ao STF para restabelecer segundo turno no Rio
item.description: The PSD filed a fundamental precept violation action (ADPF) at the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to restore the second round of the gubernatorial election in Rio de Janeiro, after Douglas Ruas was confirmed as the elected governor. The move seeks to challenge the electoral court's decision to recount votes and confirm the candidate's victory.

item.title: Como estão as rejeições a Lula e a Flávio no segundo turno, segundo a Quaest
item.description: A Genial/Quaest poll shows 54% of respondents would not vote for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), while 53% reject Lula (PT). However, 46% indicate support for Flávio, compared to 44% for Lula. The survey was conducted from October 10-13 with a 2-point error margin.

item.title: Câmara vota pacote de Lula para MEIs no mesmo dia em que Senado decide 6×1
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies will vote on Wednesday a package of benefits from the Lula government for MEIs, including an increase in the revenue ceiling and tax debt forgiveness. The main project is PL 186/26, which already has a rapporteur. The vote takes place simultaneously with the Senate decision on the PEC that ends the 6×1 scale.

item.title: Durante votação do fim da 6 X 1, Lula se reúne com senadores do MDB
item.description: President Lula meets with MDB senators during the voting of the PEC ending the 6 X 1 scale, seeking support for pension reform. Although convened by Lula, the meeting is organized by Senator Eduardo Braga, with the presence of figures such as Camilo Santana and Marcelo Castro.

item.title: Campanha de Lula aciona TSE contra Meta e questiona alcance de vídeos de Nikolas e ferramenta de IA
item.description: Lula's campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE accusing Meta of limiting the reach of posts by the candidate and his supporters, while content from allies of Flávio Bolsonaro, such as Nikolas Ferreira, allegedly received inflated distribution without justification. The coalition questions whether the platform applies selective content distribution and demands an investigation into the disproportionate reach of political videos.

item.title: Guimarães diz que Flávio Bolsonaro "fez o L" ao apoiar fim da escala 6x1
item.description: Minister José Guimarães (PT) claimed President Lula pressured Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to support ending the 6x1 work schedule, accusing the candidate of 'following L' due to popular pressure. Guimarães labeled Flávio's support as 'empty talk', suggesting PL aims to reverse the amendment in 2027 if elected. The Senate votes today on the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 schedule, proposed by Lula with reduction to 40 weekly hours.

item.title: OEA será acionada por Lula sobre interferência da Meta nas eleições
item.description: Lula's campaign filed a complaint with the OAS against Meta over alleged interference in the 2026 elections following restrictions on content delivery across social media platforms. Camilo Santana stated that the company did not respond to requests for comment and that the matter was also brought before the TSE.

item.title: STF cobra cumprimento de acesso gratuito a sites da Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: STF minister Cristiano Zanin ordered Anatel to investigate failures in free access to Electoral Justice websites following complaints during the first round of elections. The measure ensures voters with exhausted data limits can access essential voting and misinformation check information. Zanin gave Anatel 48 hours to explain the causes of failures in services like e-Título and Pardal.

item.title: Quaest: medo de reeleição de Lula empata com medo de volta dos Bolsonaro
item.description: Quaest survey reveals 43% of Brazilians fear Lula's reelection and 43% fear the return of the Bolsonaro family, with a technical tie in the second round between Flávio Bolsonaro (46%) and Lula (44%). Main fears about Lula center on corruption and economy, while fears about Bolsonaros involve authoritarianism and loss of rights.

item.title: Ministro de Lula diz não ter dúvidas de interferência dos EUA na eleição
item.description: Brazil's communication minister states there are no doubts about U.S. interference in the electoral process, accusing the country of directly influencing the election. Lula's campaign intensifies complaints against Meta, claiming biased treatment favoring Flávio Bolsonaro's content, and announces plans to bring the case to the OAS. The party also filed lawsuits alleging technical issues affecting reach of their digital content.

item.title: Flávio aciona TSE por apoio de sindicatos a Lula e quer cassar chapa rival
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE seeking to prevent unions and the UNE from supporting Lula and Alckmin, alleging electoral law violations. The complaint asks for the annulment of Lula and Alckmin's candidacies and disqualification of union leaders and social leaders for allegedly breaching campaign finance rules. The case references a joint statement signed by major unions after the first round.

item.title: Quaest: 73% dizem que votam em Lula por ele ser o melhor candidato; e 53% votam em Flávio Bolsonaro pelo mesmo motivo
item.description: A Quaest poll released on October 14 shows that 73% of Lula's voters chose him because they consider him the best candidate, while 53% of Flávio Bolsonaro's voters supported him for the same reason. The survey indicates 46% voting intentions for Flávio Bolsonaro against 44% for Lula in the second round, with a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: Quaest: proibir bets, fim da escala 6x1 e reduzir maioridade penal lideram entre propostas mais aprovadas pelos eleitores
item.description: A Quaest survey shows that proposals by Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula regarding the ban on betting sites, the end of the 6-to-1 ratio, and the reduction of the age of criminal responsibility lead among the most approved by voters. The poll evaluated nine topics, including taxes on the basic basket and minimum wage above inflation. Voters showed high approval (61-64%) for banning online betting, ending the 6-to-1 ratio, and reducing the age of criminal responsibility.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Wilson Grassi anuncia apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno
item.description: Wilson Grassi, a defeated presidential candidate from the Democrata party, endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro for the runoff, rejecting Lula. However, he sent a letter with five commitments to protect animals, demanding specific public policies.
